notifications.title: Stay up to date

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body: Adult-only pilot. Use the service lawfully and respectfully. Match and court arrangements are not guaranteed.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: We collect minimal account, profile, coarse-area, and match data to operate the pilot. Contact details are not shown to other players.

community.title: Community Rules
community.body: Be respectful, communicate honestly, protect privacy, and report unsafe or abusive behavior.
